title: Principal Process Engineer (Surge Analysis)
description:
**About us**


Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**The Role**

***As a Principal Process Engineer with Worley,***you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc….


* Surge Analysis (AFT, Pipenet) for Process as well as Fire Water network
* Lead and execute process engineering deliverables for offshore projects (concept, FEED, detailed engineering).
* Develop and review Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs), and process calculations.
* Perform and supervise process simulations, heat \& material balance calculations, and optimization studies.
* Prepare and review process design basis, philosophies, and specifications.
* Conduct or support HAZID, HAZOP, SIL, and other process safety studies.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams (piping, mechanical, instrumentation, electrical).
* Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and review their deliverables.
* Ensure compliance with client specifications, international codes/standards (API, ASME, ISO), and company procedures.
* Participate in client meetings, technical discussions, and design reviews.
* Support proposal engineering and estimation activities when required.
* Identify risks, propose mitigation measures, and ensure timely project delivery.

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes


* Mandatory Requirements
	+ Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering (Master’s preferred).
	+ Minimum 12\+ years of experience in process engineering, with strong exposure to offshore oil \& gas projects.
	+ Proven experience in FEED and detailed engineering phases.
	+ Strong knowledge of process design, equipment sizing, and offshore systems.
	+ Experience in process simulation tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, UniSim).
	+ Good understanding of process safety and risk assessment methodologies.
	Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  
	+
* Preferred Skills



	+ Prior experience working on international offshore projects.
	+ Exposure to brownfield modifications and debottlenecking studies.
	+ Familiarity with digital engineering tools and workflows.
	Ability to mentor teams and drive engineering quality.  
	+  

**Other Qualifications:**
* Key Competencies
	+ Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
	+ Leadership and team collaboration
	+ Effective communication and client\-facing skills
	+ Quality and safety mindset
	Time management and ability to work under pressure  
	+

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering expertise with experience in agent frameworks, reasoning and tool use, workflow orchestration, enterprise integrations, evaluation, guardrails, observability, cloud AI services, and responsible AI governance. By leading the architecture and delivery of intelligent agents, multi\-agent workflows, enterprise integrations, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and cloud\-native deployment patterns, the Lead AI Engineer will accelerate reliable AI adoption and measurable operational outcomes. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go\-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.

If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.

Lead technical strategy and delivery across business, engineering, operations, security, risk, and control teams to build secure, scalable Agentic AI and automation solutions.

  

* Own the technical vision, architecture, and hands\-on delivery of enterprise AI agents, multi\-agent workflows, and reusable Agentic AI platform capabilities.
* Lead the engineering of production\-grade agents that reason, use tools and APIs, manage state, recover from failures, and execute multi\-step workflows with appropriate human oversight.

The successful candidate must be a pragmatic AI engineering leader who can translate complex business use cases into reliable, testable, secure, and maintainable AI solutions. You lead a shift cluster of frontline team managers who keep Amazon's middle\-mile trucking moving in real time.
